credits.title: The Intertwining
credits.overview: Two people whose fates were switched by an embryo mix-up meet by chance. A shocking truth leads them to question who they are and begin to search for their own place in life.

credits.title: Kamen Rider Kabuto 20th: ​​The One Who Inherits the Heavens
credits.overview: 20 years after the events of the series, humans and Worms are walking towards the path of coexistence. However, ZECT is secretly developing a new Masked Rider System. Yui Kagami, the son of Arata Kagami/Kamen Rider Gatack is qualified to use the new system. Arata Kagami also investigates a ZECT conspiracy all by himsel

credits.title: Mori Hanae Butterfly Beyond
credits.overview: TV Asahi's special drama to celebrate the 100th birthday of Hanae Mori, the first female Asian haute couture designer.

credits.title: Smells Like Green Spirit the Movie
credits.overview: This is a coming-of-age story set in a closed-off rural area in the Heisei era, depicting the summer spent by Mishima Futoshi, who has just realized his identity, and the boys around him. Mishima, who was bullied by his classmate Kirino Makoto, made it a daily habit to secretly apply lipstick and wear women's clothes.

credits.title: Sana: Let Me Hear
credits.overview: During the summer vacation period, temporary teacher Honoka Kimijima is in charge of a supplementary class. One day, a female student suddenly jumps off from the school rooftop and dies in front of Honoka Kimijima.

credits.title: Strange
credits.overview: One evening a shy suburban Tokyo high school student, Odeko, meets a tearful Kuma dressed in drag in a park.  As their earnest friendship develops, Kuma's struggle to live confidently with himself changes Odeko's timidity as well.

credits.title: Your Turn to Kill: The Movie
credits.overview: Newlyweds Nana and Shota move into an apartment. Two situations, different from the drama series, take place: "What if Shota attends the resident's meeting and not Nana?" and "What if exchange murder game doesn't begin?"

credits.title: Rurouni Kenshin: The Beginning
credits.overview: Before he was a protector, Kenshin was a fearsome assassin known as Battosai. But when he meets gentle Tomoe Yukishiro, a beautiful young woman who carries a huge burden in her heart, his life will change forever.

credits.title: The Blue Hearts
credits.overview: Six directors picked a favorite song by Japanese punk rock band "The Blue Hearts" and made a short film inspired by the song.

credits.title: No Longer Heroine
credits.overview: Hatori Matsuzaki is a female high school student. She has a crush on her childhood friend Rita Terasaka and believes he will eventually choose her as her heroine, but Rita Terasaka begins dating Miho Adachi. Meanwhile, the most popular male student, Kosuke Hiromitsu takes an interest in Hatori Matsuzaki.
